description: This file contains a PHP class called `Information` within the namespace `Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog`. The class provides various methods for managing catalog information entities in an OpenCart e-commerce platform, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving information entries, descriptions, SEO URLs, layouts, and store associations. It extends a system engine model, indicating it interacts with the database and cache systems for data persistence and performance optimization.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing catalog information entries within the OpenCart admin module, including CRUD operations, descriptions, SEO URLs, layout and store associations.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Inserts a new information entry into the database, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layout configurations. Returns the newly created information ID.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Updates an existing information entry and its related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts based on the provided information ID.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Removes an information entry and all its related descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts from the database.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific information entry by its ID.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Fetches a list of information entries, optionally filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalInformations
methods.description: Returns the total count of information entries in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific information item in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific information entry.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions of an information entry across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an information entry with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes store associations for a specific information entry.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes store associations based on the store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a specific information entry.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a layout with an information entry for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes layout associations for a given information entry.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes layout associations based on layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes layout associations for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves layout associations for a specific information entry, keyed by store ID.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the total number of layout associations for a given layout ID.
